Hindustan Zinc Plans Major Capital Expenditure for Expansion

Hindustan Zinc is planning a significant capital expenditure (capex) for the fiscal year 2027. The company intends to invest ₹5,000 crore, with the majority allocated to ongoing expansion projects. Another report indicates a larger plan of ₹25,000 crore to expand refined metal capacity.
